classes.name: action
classes.description: a class that represents a type of action that can be performed in a planning domain

classes.name: parameter
classes.description: a class that represents what is involved in an action

classes.name: state
classes.description: represents a situation or a configuration of the world in a planning problem

classes.name: action effect
classes.description: a class that represents what happens after an action is done

classes.name: action precondition
classes.description: a class that represents what needs to be true before an action can be done

classes.name: domain constant
classes.description: represents a fixed entity in a planning domain

classes.name: domain predicate
classes.description: a class that represents a condition or a fact that can be true or false in a planning domain

classes.name: domain requirement
classes.description: A feature that a planning domain requires or supports

classes.name: goal state
classes.description: represents a desired or a target state defined in a task that a plan should achieve

classes.name: initial state
classes.description: represents the starting or the given state of a planning problem

classes.name: macro action
classes.description: Extracted macro action, which is a combination of multiple actions of a planning domain

classes.name: parameter type
classes.description: represents a kind of entity in a planning domain

classes.name: planner
classes.description: a system that can generate plans for a given planning domain and problem

classes.name: planner type
classes.description: a category or classification of planners based on their characteristics or features

classes.name: planning domain
classes.description: a class that represents a problem setting for automated planning

classes.name: planning problem
classes.description: represents a task of the planning domain that requires a plan to be solved

classes.name: problem object
classes.description: represents an entity or a constant that is involved in a planning problem

relations.name: solved by
relations.description: a property that relates a domain requirement to a planner that solves it

relations.name: is generated by
relations.description: a property that relates a plan to a planner that generates it

relations.name: of planner type
relations.description: a property that relates a planner to a planner type that categorizes it

relations.name: has requirement
relations.description: a property that relates a planning domain or problem to a domain requirement that is required or supported by it

relations.name: has action
relations.description: a property that relates a planning domain to a domain action that is available in it

relations.name: has constant
relations.description: a property that relates a planning domain to a domain constant that is defined in it

relations.name: has predicate
relations.description: a property that relates a planning domain to a domain predicate that is defined in it

relations.name: has high relevance planner
relations.description: a property that relates a planning domain to a planner that has a high relevance score for it

relations.name: has low relevance planner
relations.description: a property that relates a planning domain to a planner that has a low relevance score for it

relations.name: has medium relevance planner
relations.description: a property that relates a planning domain to a planner that has a medium relevance score for it

relations.name: has problem
relations.description: a property that relates a planning domain to a planning problem that is defined in it

relations.name: has parameter type
relations.description: a property that relates a planning domain to a type

relations.name: has extracted action
relations.description: a property that relates a planning domain to an action that is extracted from its plan

relations.name: has goal state
relations.description: a property that relates a planning problem to a goal state that is desired for it

relations.name: has plan
relations.description: a property that relates a planning problem to a plan that solves it

relations.name: has object
relations.description: a property that relates a planning problem to a problem object that is involved in it

relations.name: has initial state
relations.description: a property that relates a planning problem to an initial state that is given for it

relations.name: has pddltype instance
relations.description: a property that relates a type to a problem object that is an instance of it

relations.name: has tag
relations.description: a property that relates a type to a type tag that labels it

relations.name: of parameter type
relations.description: a property that relates an action parameter to a type that classifies it

relations.name: has effect
relations.description: a property that relates an action to an action effect that results from it

relations.name: has parameter
relations.description: a property that relates an action to an action parameter that is involved in it

relations.name: has precondition
relations.description: a property that relates an action to an action precondition that is required for it

relations.name: adds predicate
relations.description: a property that relates an effect to a state that adds a predicate to it

relations.name: deletes predicate
relations.description: a property that relates an effect to a state that deletes a predicate from it

relations.name: solves requirement
relations.description: a property that relates a planner to a domain requirement that it can handle or satisfy
